classification.episode_is: a verified semantic transition record: ⟨Prompt, Unfold/Field, Selection/WCR, Response, Verification⟩
classification.anti_pattern: Model says X → Log(X) → Train(X) → Model more likely says X. Self-reinforcement without verification amplifies behavior without establishing truth.

full_episode_record.formal: E_t = ⟨O_t, F_Q, Candidates, WCR, Geometry, Admission, Executors, Verdict, Evidence⟩

components.F_Q: unfolded semantic field at query time: atoms, relations, books, candidates, unresolved
components.Candidates: WCR-scored candidates from the active Fold provider
components.WCR: W, C, R, G scores per candidate with base score S = W*C*R*G
components.Geometry: fold_weight, relation_weight, phase_weight per candidate; semantic_score after lerp
components.Admission: admitted candidates with legal gate status (capable, policy_ok, xcfe_ok)
components.Executors: active micronauts / executors that produced the response
components.Verdict: GOOD | BAD | UNKNOWN — assigned by Ch'en or human feedback
components.Evidence: array of supporting evidence items used during verification

fields.atoms: array — resolved semantic atoms from fold_graph_parse
fields.candidates: array — near/eligible semantic candidates with evidence counts
fields.unresolved: array — unresolved field items; not automatic mutation requirements

fields.candidate: string — selected micronaut or track id
fields.M_cooccurrence: float — co-occurrence mass M_{Y,X} used in representation construction. NOT W_Y.
fields.W: float ∈ [0,1] — runtime selection weight (static_weight). Multiplicative prior in S = W*C*R*G.
fields.C: float ∈ [0,1] — epistemic confidence. C ← f(Evidence), not f(Usage).
fields.R: float ∈ [0,1] — relevance, provider-dependent: cosine | sdr-overlap | graph | scx
fields.G: float ∈ [0,1] — geometry bias: lerp(1, relation_weight * fold_weight * phase_weight, relation_mix)
fields.score: float — S = W * C * R * G
fields.legal: bool — capable AND policy_ok AND xcfe_ok

scoring_contract.geometry: G_Y = S_i * lerp(1, relation_weight * fold_weight * phase_weight, relation_mix)

components.R_Y: semantic match — does this candidate fit the query? Provider-dependent.
components.W_Y_C_Y: candidate qualification — how strongly should this candidate participate?
components.G_Y: geometric bias — where does this candidate sit in the Fold/Relation/Phase manifold?

M_W_distinction.M_Y_X: co-occurrence/association mass — accumulated counts from FoldPair Direction A. Feeds R_Y via the representation/provider pipeline.
M_W_distinction.W_Y: runtime selection weight (static_weight in WCR) — multiplicative prior on candidate selection. Part of S = W*C*R*G.
M_W_distinction.law: M_{Y,X} and W_Y are distinct and feed different pipeline stages. M feeds representation construction; W biases candidate selection.

laws.multiplicative_score: S = W*C*R*G is multiplicative. R=0 ⟹ S=0. High W cannot create relevance where the provider found none.
laws.legality_independent: W=1, C=1, R=1 ⟹̸ Admit unless Legal=1. Score measures fit; legality measures authority.
laws.bias_kind: W is a multiplicative selection prior, not an additive bias (not y=Wx+b). W does not add to zero-R candidates.

effects: Strengthen W_μ (increase static_weight for this candidate)
Update M_{Y,X} (co-occurrence mass — record the successful association)
Refine K_μ (key embedding if using vector provider)
Do NOT update M with this episode as positive evidence
Increment unverified count; escalate if pattern persists

verdict_contract.confidence_rule: C ← f(Evidence). Usage frequency does not change C. Only verified verdicts change C.

dataset_projections.description: A single verified episode projects to multiple specialized datasets. The EpisodeJournal is the canonical historical record; datasets are derived views.
dataset_projections.law: Training datasets are projections of verified episodes, not copies of the raw transcript journal.
dataset_projections.reconstruction_law: New Fold representations (SDR/graph/SCX/vector) can be rebuilt from the episode journal without re-collecting conversations.

journal_vs_training.EpisodeJournal: Full historical record of every episode, including UNKNOWN verdicts. Canonical. Never discarded.
journal_vs_training.TrainingDataset: Projection of verified episodes. May be rebuilt at any time from the journal.
journal_vs_training.boundary: The journal grows monotonically. The training datasets are derived on demand.
journal_vs_training.law: A training dataset that forgets the journal boundary can cause silent self-reinforcement loops.

fold_delta.description: Semantic displacement extracted from a verified episode E_i^GOOD: ΔF_i = F_i' - F_i.
fold_delta.note: The four dataset projections are not independent training datasets. They are four projections of the same semantic displacement ΔF.
fold_delta.law_delta_not_vec: ΔF ≠ vec(ΔF). The structured displacement is authoritative. A vector projection is a retrieval/indexing representation, not the displacement itself. Exactly as Fold ≠ Vector.

fold_direction.description: A reusable verified semantic transformation. The key object of the direction library.
fold_direction.formal: FoldDirection_i = ⟨ΔF_i, K_i, W_i, C_i, Evidence_i, Provenance_i⟩

fields.delta_F: ΔF_i = ⟨ΔM, ΔRelations, ΔW, ΔC⟩ — authoritative structured displacement

projections.vector: vec(ΔF_i) — for cos-similarity retrieval; lossy per projection contract

fields.K_i: Retrieval key: one projection of ΔF_i chosen by the active provider. K_i = P_v(ΔF_i).
fields.W_i: Selection prior ∈ [0,1] — how strongly should this direction participate?
fields.C_i: Evidence-based confidence ∈ [0,1]. C ← f(Evidence). Not f(usage_count).
fields.Evidence_i: Array of supporting verified episodes and verification records.
fields.Provenance_i: Source episode_ids, verdict timestamps, and Ch'en certificate references.

principal_direction.definition: K_μ = PrincipalDirection(𝒟_Q) where 𝒟_Q = {ΔF_1, ΔF_2, ..., ΔF_n} are related verified episodes.

provider_implementations.vector: PCA(vec(ΔF_i)) — first principal component of vectorized displacements
provider_implementations.graph: Consensus(ΔF_i) — intersection of relation/weight changes across episodes
provider_implementations.SDR: BitConsensus(SDR(ΔF_i)) — majority-vote bitwise AND across SDR projections

principal_direction.law: PrincipalDirection is a provider-agnostic operation. PCA is one implementation, not the semantic definition. PCA must not appear in K'UHUL semantics.

retrieval.formula: R_i = Similarity(Q, K_i) — provider-dependent (cosine, graph-overlap, SDR-popcount)
retrieval.scoring: S_i = W_i * C_i * R_i — same WCR algebra as candidate selection
retrieval.semantics: S_i means: how strongly should this previously verified semantic transformation participate here?

apply_vs_commit.apply_to_field: F_Q + α*ΔF_i → F_Q'  — temporary fold-space transformation; reversible
apply_vs_commit.commit_to_topology: B + ΔF_i → B'       — requires Proposal → Ch'en → XCFE → XulGate → B'
apply_vs_commit.law: Apply direction to Field ≠ commit direction to Topology. A retrieved direction can steer semantic computation without mutating the permanent graph.

direction_library.description: Derived reusable knowledge, built from the episode journal. Not a training dataset.

four_layer_separation.Journal: Evidence — full historical record of every episode
four_layer_separation.FoldDelta: Learned transition — ΔF_i extracted from GOOD episodes
four_layer_separation.DirectionLibrary: Derived reusable knowledge — FoldDirections indexed for retrieval
four_layer_separation.Projection_Index: Retrieval optimization — provider-specific vectors/SDR/SCX of ΔF_i

direction_library.derivation_law: J_GOOD → DirectionLibrary_v. The library is derived from the journal, not collected independently.
direction_library.reprojection_law: When the representation changes (e.g. vector → SDR), re-project from J_GOOD. Do not re-collect experiences.
direction_library.pipeline: EpisodeJournal --[GOOD verdict]--> ΔF --[alignment/consensus]--> FoldDirections --[WCR]--> SelectedDirection --[apply]--> F_Q'
